title: 9 Signs a Godly Man Actually Has Brothers (Not Just Contacts)
caption:
9 signs a godly man actually has brothers, not just contacts.

He can name the one guy who'd drive at 2 a.m. He's been confronted and didn't ghost the group chat. He's shown up for a move, a hospital, a bad week, not just a birthday. He'd rather have three men who know his sin than three hundred who know his highlight reel.

A contact list can look full while a man is starving for the real thing. Brotherhood isn't the number of names in your phone. It's who actually notices when you go quiet.

"Two are better than one... if either of them falls down, one can help the other up." (Ecclesiastes 4:9-10)
